chapterInfo.content:
4
Monsɔ ahonhom no nhwɛ
1 # 1 Te 5.21 Adɔfo, monnnye ahonhom nyinaa nnni, na mmom monsɔ ahonhom no nhwɛ sɛ wɔfiri Onyankopɔn anaa; ɛfiri sɛ adiyifoɔ atorofoɔ bebree aba wiase. 2Yei mu na monhunu Nyankopɔn honhom. Honhom biara a ɔpae mu ka sɛ Yesu Kristo aba honam mu no firi Nyankopɔn mu. 3#1 Yoh 2.18 Na honhom biara a ɔnka sɛ Yesu aba (honam mu) no mfiri Nyankopɔn mu. Na yei ne antikristo a moate sɛ ɔreba na afei wanya aba wiase no deɛ.
4Mma nkumaa, mofiri Nyankopɔn mu, na moadi wɔn so nkonim, ɛfiri sɛ deɛ ɔwɔ mo mu no so kyɛne deɛ ɔwɔ wiase mu. 5#Yoh 15.19 Wɔn deɛ, wɔfiri wiase. Yei nti na wɔfiri wiase kasa, na wiase tie wɔn. 6#Yoh 8.47 Yɛn deɛ, yɛfiri Nyankopɔn mu. Deɛ ɔnim Nyankopɔn no tie yɛn, na deɛ ɔmfiri Onyankopɔn mu no ntie yɛn. Yei mu na yɛhunu nokorɛ honhom ne nnaadaa honhom.
Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔdɔ
7Adɔfo, momma yɛnnodɔ yɛn ho; na ɔdɔ firi Nyankopɔn, na obiara a ɔdɔ no, Onyankopɔn na wawo no, na ɔnim Onyankopɔn. 8Deɛ ɔnnɔ no, nhunuu Onyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn ne ɔdɔ. 9#Yoh 3.16 Yei mu na Nyankopɔn dɔ no yii ne ho adie wɔ yɛn ho, sɛ Onyankopɔn somaa ne Ba a ɔwoo no koro no baa wiase sɛ yɛmfa ne so nnya nkwa. 10#1 Yoh 2.2 Yei mu na ɔdɔ no wɔ, ɛnyɛ sɛ yɛn na yɛdɔɔ Onyankopɔn, na mmom ɔno na ɔdɔɔ yɛn na ɔsomaa ne Ba sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ yɛn bɔne ho mpata.
11 # Mat 18.33 Adɔfo, sɛ Onyankopɔn dɔɔ yɛn sɛɛ a, ɛnneɛ ɛsɛ yɛn nso sɛ yɛdodɔ yɛn ho yɛn ho. 12#Yoh 1.18 Obi nhunuu Onyankopɔn pɛn. Sɛ yɛdodɔ yɛn ho yɛn ho a, na Onyankopɔn te yɛn mu, na ne dɔ no awie pɛyɛ wɔ yɛn mu. 13#1 Yoh 3.24 Yei mu na yɛhunu sɛ yɛte ne mu, na ɔno nso te yɛn mu, sɛ wama yɛn ne honhom. 14#Yoh 3.17 Na yɛahunu na yɛdi adanseɛ sɛ, Agya no asoma Ɔba no sɛ wiase Agyenkwa. 15#1 Yoh 5.5 Obiara a ɔpae mu ka sɛ Yesu ne Nyankopɔn Ba no, Onyankopɔn te ne mu, na ɔno nso te Nyankopɔn mu. 16#1 Yoh 4.8 Na yɛn deɛ, yɛahunu na yɛagye ɔdɔ a Onyankopɔn wɔ no yɛn ho no adi. Onyankopɔn ne ɔdɔ, na deɛ ɔte ɔdɔ mu no te Nyankopɔn mu, na Onyankopɔn te no mu.
17 # 1 Yoh 2.28 Yei mu na ɔdɔ no awie pɛyɛ wɔ yɛn mu, na yɛanya nnamyɛ atemmuda da, ɛfiri sɛ sɛdeɛ ɔno teɛ no, sɛ nso yɛteɛ wɔ wiase ha ne no. 18Ehu nni dɔ mu, na mmom ɔdɔ a ɛdi mu no pam ehu, ɛfiri sɛ ehu ne asotwe na ɛnam, na deɛ ɔsuro no nwiee pɛyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ mu. 19Yɛdɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔdɔɔ yɛn kane. 20Sɛ obi ka sɛ: Medɔ Onyankopɔn, na ɔtane ne nua a, ɔyɛ ɔtorofoɔ. Na deɛ ɔnnɔ ne nua a ɔhu no no, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ɔbɛtumi adɔ Onyankopɔn a ɔnhunuu no? 21#Mar 12.29-31 Na ahyɛdeɛ yi na yɛanya no ne nkyɛn sɛ, deɛ ɔdɔ Onyankopɔn no, ɔnnɔ ne nua nso.

Adɔfo, monnnye ahonhom nyinaa nnni, na mmom monsɔ ahonhom no nhwɛ sɛ wɔfiri Onyankopɔn anaa; ɛfiri sɛ adiyifoɔ atorofoɔ bebree aba wiase. Yei mu na monhunu Nyankopɔn honhom. Honhom biara a ɔpae mu ka sɛ Yesu Kristo aba honam mu no firi Nyankopɔn mu. Na honhom biara a ɔnka sɛ Yesu aba (honam mu) no mfiri Nyankopɔn mu. Na yei ne antikristo a moate sɛ ɔreba na afei wanya aba wiase no deɛ.
Mma nkumaa, mofiri Nyankopɔn mu, na moadi wɔn so nkonim, ɛfiri sɛ deɛ ɔwɔ mo mu no so kyɛne deɛ ɔwɔ wiase mu. Wɔn deɛ, wɔfiri wiase. Yei nti na wɔfiri wiase kasa, na wiase tie wɔn. Yɛn deɛ, yɛfiri Nyankopɔn mu. Deɛ ɔnim Nyankopɔn no tie yɛn, na deɛ ɔmfiri Onyankopɔn mu no ntie yɛn. Yei mu na yɛhunu nokorɛ honhom ne nnaadaa honhom.

Adɔfo, momma yɛnnodɔ yɛn ho; na ɔdɔ firi Nyankopɔn, na obiara a ɔdɔ no, Onyankopɔn na wawo no, na ɔnim Onyankopɔn. Deɛ ɔnnɔ no, nhunuu Onyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn ne ɔdɔ. Yei mu na Nyankopɔn dɔ no yii ne ho adie wɔ yɛn ho, sɛ Onyankopɔn somaa ne Ba a ɔwoo no koro no baa wiase sɛ yɛmfa ne so nnya nkwa. Yei mu na ɔdɔ no wɔ, ɛnyɛ sɛ yɛn na yɛdɔɔ Onyankopɔn, na mmom ɔno na ɔdɔɔ yɛn na ɔsomaa ne Ba sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ yɛn bɔne ho mpata.
Adɔfo, sɛ Onyankopɔn dɔɔ yɛn sɛɛ a, ɛnneɛ ɛsɛ yɛn nso sɛ yɛdodɔ yɛn ho yɛn ho. Obi nhunuu Onyankopɔn pɛn. Sɛ yɛdodɔ yɛn ho yɛn ho a, na Onyankopɔn te yɛn mu, na ne dɔ no awie pɛyɛ wɔ yɛn mu. Yei mu na yɛhunu sɛ yɛte ne mu, na ɔno nso te yɛn mu, sɛ wama yɛn ne honhom. Na yɛahunu na yɛdi adanseɛ sɛ, Agya no asoma Ɔba no sɛ wiase Agyenkwa. Obiara a ɔpae mu ka sɛ Yesu ne Nyankopɔn Ba no, Onyankopɔn te ne mu, na ɔno nso te Nyankopɔn mu. Na yɛn deɛ, yɛahunu na yɛagye ɔdɔ a Onyankopɔn wɔ no yɛn ho no adi. Onyankopɔn ne ɔdɔ, na deɛ ɔte ɔdɔ mu no te Nyankopɔn mu, na Onyankopɔn te no mu.
Yei mu na ɔdɔ no awie pɛyɛ wɔ yɛn mu, na yɛanya nnamyɛ atemmuda da, ɛfiri sɛ sɛdeɛ ɔno teɛ no, sɛ nso yɛteɛ wɔ wiase ha ne no. Ehu nni dɔ mu, na mmom ɔdɔ a ɛdi mu no pam ehu, ɛfiri sɛ ehu ne asotwe na ɛnam, na deɛ ɔsuro no nwiee pɛyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ mu. Yɛdɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔdɔɔ yɛn kane. Sɛ obi ka sɛ: Medɔ Onyankopɔn, na ɔtane ne nua a, ɔyɛ ɔtorofoɔ. Na deɛ ɔnnɔ ne nua a ɔhu no no, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ɔbɛtumi adɔ Onyankopɔn a ɔnhunuu no? Na ahyɛdeɛ yi na yɛanya no ne nkyɛn sɛ, deɛ ɔdɔ Onyankopɔn no, ɔnnɔ ne nua nso.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
